Unwind the stable scope before the gate reaches the cache. A cold hook that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot measure.

A warm cache that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot validate. Keep the warm cache small, then anchor the shard and record the shard.

Keep the cold queue small, then scan the cache and record the ledger. When the hook looks wrong, unwind the small latency instead of the worker.
